import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import genbig
S = 10000
T = 4 * S
O = 5000
fab = genbig.big_fabric(seed=3, S_=None) if False else genbig.big_fabric(seed=3)
prof = genbig.big_profile()
fab['interval_ns'] = T; fab['slice_ns'] = S; fab['offset_ns'] = O
for lk in fab['links']:
    lk['delay_ns'] = [random.Random(lk['ends'][0][0]*31+lk['ends'][1][0]).randint(1, 8000),
                      random.Random(lk['ends'][0][0]*17+lk['ends'][1][0]).randint(1, 8000)]
fab['drift_ppb'] = [1]*fab['n']
fab['heat'] = [[i % fab['n'], i % 128, (i % 128)+1, 1] for i in range(50)]
fab['reconfig_ns'] = 0
fab['guards_ns'] = [100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 1500, 1900]
json.dump(fab, open('/tmp/bigfab2.json','w'))
json.dump(prof, open('/tmp/bigprof2.json','w'))
print('ok')
EOF
python3 /tmp/genbig2.py && timeout 900 python3 -B /tmp/timeplan2.py
